varied_params.label: Stop-loss distance
varied_params.note: Added as a 4th varied dimension by the sl_extension stage below. Was a fixed_param (3.0 only) for the base/width_extension/ratio_boundary_extension stages.

notes: Run in 8 chunks (one per width value, 195 candidates each) due to size; sources.json lists all 8 source batch_ids.

tp_sl_ratio.note: 5.5 and 6.0 additionally computed for min_current_width_atr in {7,8,9,10} only, at sl_atr_multiplier=3.0 (boundary extension, not a full rectangle)

sl_atr_multiplier.note: 3.0 is the base value used by base/width_extension/ratio_boundary_extension stages (2850 rows). 3.5 and 2.75 are each a full 14x15x13 rectangle (2730 rows each), ratio range 2.0-5.0 only (the 5.5/6.0 boundary points exist only at sl=3.0).

history.note: partial rectangle: only width 7-10 x ratio {5.5,6.0}, not full width range

Full 14x15x13 rectangle at a new stop-loss distance (3.5 ATR instead of the base 3.0 ATR). TP computed by the same canonical ratio semantics: tp_atr_multiplier = sl_atr_multiplier x tp_sl_ratio. Executed as a single 2730-candidate range-batch (no width/lookback/ratio chunking), one Strategy Engine process, one EvaluationContext. Wall time ~6039s (2026-09-27T18:47:03Z -> ~20:27:42Z), 0 failed. Not compared/interpreted here; adds sl_atr_multiplier as this dataset's 4th varied dimension.

Full 14x15x13 rectangle at a second new stop-loss distance (2.75 ATR, testing the opposite boundary from the closed SL=3.0->3.5 direction per findings f017/f018). Same canonical ratio semantics: tp_atr_multiplier = sl_atr_multiplier x tp_sl_ratio. Executed as a single 2730-candidate range-batch, one Strategy Engine process, one EvaluationContext. Wall time ~5147s (2026-09-28T08:04:47Z -> ~09:45:34Z), 0 failed.

note: Canonical merged dataset for this study. Combines base (width 1-8), width extension (width 9-14), ratio boundary extension (ratio 5.5/6.0 for width 7-10 only, sl=3.0), and two sl extensions (full width/lookback/ratio rectangles at sl=3.5 and sl=2.75) into one runs.csv, verbatim rows with original run_id/source_batch_id/market_data_hash preserved. No recompute. 8310 unique rows (identity = width, lookback, ratio, sl_atr_multiplier), no duplicates. Superseded folders: width_x_untouched_x_ratio_3d_ext_w09_14, _combined, _boundary_w07_10_r55_60, _boundary_compare (all merged/derived-view only, no unique evidence lost).
